The Library links to research on caregiving. Each work has a short summary in our own words, is
tagged by theme, and sits in an area a reader can open on its own. Each area is searched again every
month. A model drafts every entry, and a person approves it before it is listed.

## Areas

{{< include _areas.md >}}

## Themes {#themes}

Every entry carries one or more of these twelve themes. Each theme names the subject headings from
the U.S. National Library of Medicine's Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) that fit it, so the same
subject can be searched for in PubMed. A theme gets an area page once its entries have been gathered
and approved.

{{< include _themes.md >}}

## Using the Library

The summaries, themes and other fields are ours, under [CC BY 4.0](https://github.com/haau3/research/blob/main/LICENSE-CC-BY-4.0).
Each work belongs to its authors: follow its title to read it. Every entry is in
[one CSL-JSON file](https://github.com/haau3/research/blob/main/library/references.json) that
reference managers such as Zotero can import. To suggest a work or correct an
entry, open an issue on [the repository](https://github.com/haau3/research/issues).
